capacities.name: Awareness
capacities.question: What is happening, and what information is missing?
capacities.description: Maintains decision-relevant context between requests and closes consequential information gaps.

subdimensions.name: Active perception & proactive information seeking
works: Ask Early, Ask Late, Ask Right

capacities.name: Anticipation
capacities.question: What may happen, and could acting improve the outcome?
capacities.description: Connects forecasts and counterfactuals to the expected value of possible interventions.

capacities.name: Agenda
capacities.question: Which candidate goals deserve sustained commitment?
capacities.description: Turns forecasts into prioritized intentions that persist and evolve across interactions.

capacities.name: Arbitration
capacities.question: Is intervention well-founded, worthwhile, timely, and safe?
capacities.description: Gates initiative using uncertainty, utility, timing, risk, and reversibility.

capacities.name: Action
capacities.question: How much work should the agent perform before returning control, and how should it present the intervention?
capacities.description: Resolves unspecified details within granted authority while preserving human control over consequential commitments.

subdimensions.name: Spectrum of autonomy & interaction paradigm
works: Levels of Autonomy for AI Agents

capacities.name: Adaptation
capacities.question: Was the initiative warranted, and what should change?
capacities.description: Uses outcomes and feedback for fast reflection and slower calibration of future initiative.
